title: Plant Manager
location: Fort Wayne metropolitan area, IN, USA
text:
LHH is seeking a Plant Manager for a Direct Hire, Permanent Placement position with a manufacturing client located near Fort Wayne, IN. This is an opportunity to lead a growing manufacturing operation where you will have significant autonomy and direct influence over business and operational performance. You will join an existing team, provide guidance, drive business growth, and lead critical projects with key customers. The compensation is commensurate to experience and will range between $140,000–165,000 per year plus bonus and includes comprehensive benefit and insurance plans, generous Paid Time Off, and a 401K plan with a company match.

***\*\*\*Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without employer sponsorship.\*\*\****

**JOB RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Provide overall leadership and direction for across the manufacturing facility.
* Build an engaged, accountable culture through visible leadership, open communication, coaching, and employee development.
* Evaluate production performance and operating data to identify opportunities for efficiency, capacity, and cost improvements.
* Lead continuous improvement initiatives that increase productivity, reduce waste, and deliver measurable financial results.
* Manage staffing, training, labor utilization, production schedules, and resources to support changing business requirements.
* Review and improve operating procedures, standard work, and processes to strengthen consistency and accountability.
* Develop operating budgets and manage plant spending with a strong focus on profitability and cost control.
* Lead strategic planning activities and establish performance measures that support key organizational objectives.
* Direct capital investments and special projects from planning through implementation and performance validation.
* Improve equipment reliability, utilization, manufacturing capacity, and overall operational effectiveness.
* Maintain strong customer service while balancing production priorities, operating costs, and delivery expectations.
* Foster collaboration across departments and effectively lead employees with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and personalities.
* Maintain a strong safety culture and ensure operations comply with applicable workplace and regulatory requirements.
* Proactively identify operational risks, develop practical action plans, and follow initiatives through completion.
* Partner with technical and business leaders to support long-term growth and continuous operational improvement.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

* **Bachelor Degree in Engineering, Business Management, Operations, or related field is preferred**
* **Minimum of 10+ years of leadership experience within a manufacturing facility is required**
* **Must have at least 5+ years of experience at the Plant Manager level**
* **Must have the ability to manage P&L, labor costs, scheduling, capacity, and capital expenditures**
* Must have experience with ERP/MRP systems and data-driven operational reporting
* Ideal candidates will have experience with Lean Manufacturing
* Strong communication, analytical, problem-solving, and cross-functional leadership skills.
* **Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without employer sponsorship.**

If you or someone in your network fit this profile and would like to apply for this Plant Manager position near Fort Wayne, IN then please submit your application alongside your resume using the link in this posting.

**Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled**

To read our Candidate Privacy Information Statement, which explains how we will use your information, please navigate to https://www.lhh.com/us/en/candidate-privacy
